description: Time-series observations for one or more Bank of Canada series. Pass comma-separated series names. Well-known: FXUSDCAD (USD/CAD daily avg rate), FXEURCAD (EUR/CAD), V39079 (target for the overnight rate / policy rate), V41690973 (Total CPI). Choose either recent=N latest points OR a start_date/end_date window.

end_date.description: Window end, YYYY-MM-DD (optional, defaults to latest).

recent.description: Return the N most recent observations. Ignored if start_date is given.

name: get_observations
title: Get Observations
